e.title: LifeInsureR
e.summary: 传统寿险合约建模（CRAN 1.0.1）：R6 类建模年金/寿险/定期寿险（LifeInsuranceContracts 继任者）
e.summary_en: Traditional life insurance contract modelling (CRAN 1.0.1): R6 classes for annuities/whole life/endowments (successor of LifeInsuranceContracts)
e.summary_hk: 傳統壽險合約建模（CRAN 1.0.1）：R6 類建模年金/壽險/定期壽險（LifeInsuranceContracts 繼任者）
e.body: LifeInsureR（CRAN 1.0.1，Reinhold Kainhofer）用 R6 类建模传统寿险合约：年金、终身寿险、定期寿险（带利润参与/动态增长/合约变更）——LifeInsuranceContracts（已弃用）的继任者，现金流导向的通用建模框架。对 RIAA：寿险合约的 R 建模框架——[[lifelib]]（Python 寿险模型）的 R 对照；现金流导向（利润参与/动态增长）适合 IFRS 17 与分红险建模（[[ifrs17-calculation-engine-py]] 配套）；与 [[actuarialmath]]（FAM-L 大纲）、[[lifepack]]（数值准备金）配套；适合寿险产品建模方向。
e.body_en: LifeInsureR (CRAN 1.0.1, Reinhold Kainhofer) models traditional life insurance contracts with R6 classes: annuities, whole life, term insurance (with profit participation/dynamic increases/contract changes) — the successor of the deprecated LifeInsuranceContracts, a cash-flow-oriented generic framework. For RIAA: the R modelling framework for life contracts — the R counterpart of [[lifelib]] (Python life models); cash-flow orientation (profit participation/dynamic increases) suits IFRS 17 and participating products (pairs with [[ifrs17-calculation-engine-py]]); with [[actuarialmath]] (FAM-L syllabus) and [[lifepack]] (numerical reserving); suits life product modelling.
e.body_hk: LifeInsureR（CRAN 1.0.1，Reinhold Kainhofer）用 R6 類建模傳統壽險合約：年金、終身壽險、定期壽險（帶利潤參與/動態增長/合約變更）——LifeInsuranceContracts（已棄用）的繼任者，現金流導向的通用建模框架。對 RIAA：壽險合約的 R 建模框架——[[lifelib]]（Python 壽險模型）的 R 對照；現金流導向（利潤參與/動態增長）適合 IFRS 17 與分紅險建模（[[ifrs17-calculation-engine-py]] 配套）；與 [[actuarialmath]]（FAM-L 大綱）、[[lifepack]]（數值準備金）配套；適合壽險產品建模方向。
